# Frame365

> Frame365 is a quiet, private daily photo diary and visual journal app for iOS (iPhone). It helps users capture one meaningful photo a day with a short note and automatic city location, turning everyday moments into a visual calendar, 30D–365D photo mosaic, Home Screen streak widget, and interactive world travel map.

## Core Features
- **One Frame a Day:** Distraction-free daily photo journaling without social feeds, followers, or likes.
- **Home Screen & Lock Screen Widgets:** Displays current daily streak and the last 7 captured frames.
- **Visual Calendar & Mosaic:** Monthly circular photo calendar and exportable 30-day / 365-day visual mosaic Story posters.
- **Interactive Travel Map & Cities:** Automatically organizes frames by city and neighborhood on an interactive world map.
- **Privacy-First Architecture:** Local storage and personal Apple iCloud sync with Face ID / Passcode protection. Zero external social servers.
